items.title: de.mhus.vance.ode:vance-ode-core 0.1.0 发布, Shared by both directions: connection configuration, error model, HTTP transport, and the little that every inbound endpoint needs (shared-secret guard, error body). Its Spring Web dependencies are provided-scoped and therefore not transitive, so a consumer that only talks outbound still inherits no servlet stack. No controller lives here — that is what would break the promise.

ws.schild:jave-nativebin-osxm1 4.1.0 发布, The JAVE (Java Audio Video Encoder) library is Java wrapper on the 
        ffmpeg project. Developers can take take advantage of JAVE2 to transcode 
        audio and video files from a format to another. In example you can transcode 
        an AVI file to a MPEG one, you can change a DivX video stream into a 
        (youtube like) Flash FLV one, you can convert a WAV audio file to a MP3 or 
        a Ogg Vorbis one, you can separate and transcode audio and video tracks, 
        you can resize videos, changing their sizes and proportions and so on. 
        Many other formats, containers and operations are supported by JAVE2.

ws.schild:jave-nativebin-osx64 4.1.0 发布, DEPRECATED. This package carries the ffmpeg binary for intel macs.
        Apple ends support for intel hardware with macOS 27, so this package will be
        removed in a later release. On apple silicon use jave-nativebin-osxm1, which
        is unaffected. It is still built and published for now, and jave-all-deps
        still contains it, so nothing breaks today.

        The JAVE (Java Audio Video Encoder) library is Java wrapper on the
        ffmpeg project. Developers can take take advantage of JAVE2 to transcode
        audio and video files from a format to another. In example you can transcode
        an AVI file to a MPEG one, you can change a DivX video stream into a
        (youtube like) Flash FLV one, you can convert a WAV audio file to a MP3 or
        a Ogg Vorbis one, you can separate and transcode audio and video tracks,
        you can resize videos, changing their sizes and proportions and so on.
        Many other formats, containers and operations are supported by JAVE2.

ws.schild:jave-bom 4.1.0 发布, A bill of materials for JAVE2. Import it and the version of every jave
        artifact is settled in one place, so a project picking its own platform packages
        cannot end up with a core and a native binary from different releases, which is
        the usual way this goes wrong.

        Import it under dependencyManagement with scope import, then declare the jave
        artifacts you want without a version.

ws.schild:jave-nativebin-win-arm64 4.1.0 发布, The JAVE (Java Audio Video Encoder) library is Java wrapper on the 
        ffmpeg project. Developers can take take advantage of JAVE2 to transcode 
        audio and video files from a format to another. In example you can transcode 
        an AVI file to a MPEG one, you can change a DivX video stream into a 
        (youtube like) Flash FLV one, you can convert a WAV audio file to a MP3 or 
        a Ogg Vorbis one, you can separate and transcode audio and video tracks, 
        you can resize videos, changing their sizes and proportions and so on. 
        Many other formats, containers and operations are supported by JAVE2.
